before.text: Per key-record-model-v2.md §7: import --kind key --in FILE|--stdin (PKCS#8 DER/PEM, optional --passphrase-stdin) via SecItemImport into the login keychain with kSecAttrIsExtractable and SecAccess ACL per --extraction; import --kind secret --stdin (raw bytes/text, never argv) as a Keychain secret item; algorithm detected and validated against the registry; record fields as init; origin.source imported:<sha256>; prints source_still_on_disk for file inputs and never modifies or deletes the source; interop: a key imported from Go-generated PKCS#8 signs (T2) and the signature verifies with the original Go public key.

after.text: Per key-record-model-v2.md §7 incl. Import detection: import --service S --purpose P --in FILE|--stdin with kind/algorithm/representation detected from the input (PEM headers, then ASN.1 probes PKCS#8 -> SPKI -> X.509 -> PKCS#7 -> PKCS#12); --kind optional and refused when it contradicts detection; unrecognized input refused unless --as-secret; PKCS#12 yields key + certificate records; private keys via SecItemImport with kSecAttrIsExtractable and SecAccess ACL per --extraction; secrets from stdin only, never argv; origin.source imported:<sha256>; prints source_still_on_disk for file inputs and never modifies or deletes the source. Public kinds share the detector with T4; T8 owns the detector module and the private-kind paths.
